topIssues.title: Security Analysis: 11 potential vulnerabilities detected in superchain-ops
topIssues.author: 0xRAMlabs
topIssues.body:
Hi 👋

We are **[0xRAM Labs](https://0xram.com)**, a Web3 security research firm. Our automated security scanner analyzed the smart contracts in this repository and identified **11 potential vulnerabilities**.

### 🔍 Summary of Findings

| Metric | Value |
|--------|-------|
| Total Issues | 11 |
| Highest Severity | High |
| Top Finding | Denial of Service (DoS) via unbounded array loop |

### 🚨 Most Critical Finding

**Denial of Service (DoS) via unbounded array loop** (`High`)
> Line 206 contains a `for` loop that appears to iterate over the length of a dynamic array. If the array grows too large, the gas cost to execute the loop will exceed the block gas limit, causing the function to become permanently unusable.

This is just a preview — the full analysis covers all 11 findings with detailed remediation guidance.

### 📊 Full Security Report

We've generated a detailed, interactive security report for your review:

👉 **[View Full Report](https://0xram.com/report/report-4r9xsj04r)**

topPRs.title: Type A Migration Exercise Tasks
topPRs.author: Wazabie
topPRs.body:
Scaffold migrations-sop-1 chain migration tasks (076–081)

Adds six sepolia tasks for migrating the migrations-sop-1 devnet (chainId 420120110) from Partner-operated to OP-operated infrastructure:

076 — add FaultDisputeGame (game type 0) via OPCM
077 — set OptimismPortal respected game type to 0
078 — transfer SystemConfig ownership from Partner EOA → OPE Admin Safe (EOA-signed off-chain; ships as documented cast send flow)
079 — set OP batcher + unsafe block signer
080 — rotate PDG proposer to OP via DisputeGameFactory.setImplementation
081 — upgrade fee-vault proxies to OP recipients via L1→L2 deposit
Each task ships config.toml, addresses.json (fallback — chain not in superchain-registry), README.md, VALIDATION.md, and .env. <TBD_*> placeholders mark chain-specific values (prestate, ProxyAdmin, PDG game args, fee-vault impls, Safe nonces) the operator fills in at execution time.

topPRs.title: U19 betanet tasks
topPRs.author: Wazabie
topPRs.body:
## Summary

Adds four Sepolia tasks for Upgrade 19 on the OP Labs Betanets (`u19-beta-0` permissioned, `u19-beta-1` flipped to permissionless), plus a CI fix to clear a stale fork-block pin.

Chain identification from [betanets/u19-beta/manifest.yaml](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/devnets/blob/main/betanets/u19-beta/manifest.yaml):
- `u19-beta-0` (chainId `420120035`) — stays permissioned.
- `u19-beta-1` (chainId `420120036`) — has the `fp-permissionless` feature flag; flipped to permissionless before its U19 upgrade.

### Tasks

- **`076-U19-op-betanet-permissioned`** — `OPCMUpgradeV700` upgrade of `u19-beta-0`. Stays permissioned; \`expectedValidationErrors\` keeps `PLDG-10`; \`startingRespectedGameType = 8\` (CANNON_KONA) per U19 design.
- **`077-betanet-set-dispute-game-impl-permissionless`** — `SetDisputeGameImpl` on `u19-beta-1`. Wires \`gameImpls(CANNON=0) → 0x6dDBa09bc4cCB0D6Ca9Fc5350580f74165707499\` (the shared \`FaultDisputeGame\` impl op-deployer already deployed for u19-beta) and sets \`initBonds(CANNON) = 0.08 ETH\`. Re-uses \`DelayedWethPermissionedGameProxy\` (mirroring sepolia task 050). No new game contract is deployed — this template directly calls \`factory.setImplementation(…)\`. \`PERMISSIONED_CANNON\` is passed through unchanged.
- **`078-betanet-set-respected-game-type-permissionless`** — `SetRespectedGameTypeTemplate` on `u19-beta-1`, flipping \`ASR.respectedGameType\` from \`PERMISSIONED_CANNON\` (1) to permissionless \`CANNON\` (0). Signed as the betanet ProxyAdminOwner Safe (same override used in sepolia task 051 — betanet ASR checks \`msg.sender == SystemConfig.guardian()\` and the guardian is the PAO EOA, not a separate GuardianSafe multisig). Together with 077, this makes u19-beta-1 officially permissionless.
- **`079-U19-op-betanet-permissionless`** — `OPCMUpgradeV700` upgrade of `u19-beta-1` once permissionless. Same shape as 076; \`expectedValidationErrors\` still keeps \`PLDG-10\` (see below).

Each task folder contains \`README.md\`, \`VALIDATION.md\`, \`addresses.json\`, \`config.toml\`, and \`.env\` (\`TENDERLY_GAS=15000000\`). The "make u19-beta-1 permissionless" pair (077 + 078) is the U19-era analogue of U18's 050 + 051 flip, but using \`SetDisputeGameImpl\` instead of \`AddGameType\` since the shared v7.1.17 \`FaultDisputeGame\` impl is already deployed — we only need to wire it, not deploy a new instance.

### Test outcome (077 → 079)

077 was added in part to **test empirically whether V700's OPCM preserves or zeros out \`gameImpls(CANNON)\` during the upgrade.** The pre-upgrade state set up by 077 (\`gameImpls(CANNON) = 0x6dDBa…\`) lets the simulation trace conclusively answer this. The result: **V700 explicitly zeros the FDG slot.** The OPCM trace in 079 shows \`factory.setImplementation(0, 0x0, "")\` being called on u19-beta-1's DGF, matching \`OPCMUpgradeV700._isEnabled(CANNON) = false\`. As a consequence, \`PLDG-10\` is unavoidable post-U19: even though the chain is functionally permissionless via \`CANNON_KONA\`, the standard validator's \`assertValidPermissionlessDisputeGame\` still checks \`gameImpls(CANNON)\` (which is zero post-upgrade) and emits \`PLDG-10\`. This is an artifact of the validator not yet understanding U19's deprecation of \`CANNON\` in favor of \`CANNON_KONA\`. Documented in 079's config.

### CI fix

- Removed the stale \`FORK_BLOCK_NUMBER=10280290\` pin from cancelled tasks \`068-fus-rotation\`, \`069-sc-rotation\`, \`070-fos-rotation\`, \`071-chain-governor-rotation\`. The justfile's full-stack \`simulate-stack\` lookup (\`src/justfile:101-110\`) is status-blind — it \`find\`s every \`.env\` under \`src/tasks/sep\` in version order and uses the first \`FORK_BLOCK_NUMBER\` it sees, even if that task itself is terminal. Pre-fix, that produced \`script failed: OPCMUpgradeV800: SuperchainConfig has no code\` on this PR because the U19 betanet SuperchainConfig was deployed after block 10280290. Underlying justfile flaw documented but left for a follow-up.

### Open follow-ups

- \`cannonPrestate\` / \`cannonKonaPrestate\` are \`0xdead…\` placeholders in 076 + 079 — swap for the U19 betanet release prestates once published (Notion / standard-prestates.toml).
- \`OPCM = 0x44e197058fb98fb3618453b3d90cdef6f5db8297\` is the v7.1.17 dev OPCM from PR #1408 — swap to the production U19 OPCM proxy once it lands in \`standard-versions-sepolia.toml\`.
- PAO Safe nonce state-overrides are pinned to current on-chain (83) and stacked (84/85/86); re-fetch and bump if other PAO-signed work executes before this stack runs.
- 077 uses a \`prevFdgImpl = fdgImpl\` workaround because \`SetDisputeGameImpl._validateBasicInvariants\` calls \`newFdg.l2ChainId()\` on the impl, which returns \`0\` for the shared blueprint-style v7.1.17 \`FaultDisputeGame\` (chain-specific data lives in \`gameArgs\`, not in immutables). Worth tightening that template upstream.

## Test plan

- [x] \`just simulate-stack sep 076-U19-op-betanet-permissioned\`
- [x] \`just simulate-stack sep 077-betanet-set-dispute-game-impl-permissionless\`
- [x] \`just simulate-stack sep 078-betanet-set-respected-game-type-permissionless\`
- [x] \`just simulate-stack sep 079-U19-op-betanet-permissionless\` (stack exits 0, 4 Tenderly links, no validation errors)
- [x] Trace confirms 077 wires \`gameImpls(CANNON) = 0x6dDBa…7499\` on u19-beta-1, and 079 zeros it back to \`0x0\` (the test we wanted).
- [ ] Re-fetch PAO Safe nonce immediately before signing and bump all four \`stateOverrides\` if it has drifted.
- [ ] Replace placeholder prestates and dev OPCM once production values are published.

topPRs.title: FeeVaultUpgradeTemplate: add optional L2 ProxyAdmin owner pre-flight check
topPRs.author: Wazabie
topPRs.body:
## Summary

- Adds an opt-in L2 ProxyAdmin owner pre-flight check to `FeeVaultUpgradeTemplate`, gated on a new optional `l2RpcUrls` TOML field
- Catches the failure mode where the L1 Safe tx executes successfully but the L2 `upgradeAndCall` deposits silently revert with `onlyOwner` because the L2 ProxyAdmin isn't owned by the aliased L1 PAO
- Backward compatible: when `l2RpcUrls` is absent, a warning is printed and the check is skipped — existing tasks and the 034 arena-z regression fixture run unchanged

## Motivation

While verifying [085-migrations-sop-1-fee-vault-update](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/tree/main/src/tasks/sep/085-migrations-sop-1-fee-vault-update) we found that the L1 task tx (https://sepolia.etherscan.io/tx/0x4e92b55e0e944ac89743f7562393a929d8efd82dfdb94972ac5a43b02b9edd12) succeeded and emitted all 7 expected `TransactionDeposited` events, but the 4 `upgradeAndCall` deposits all reverted on L2 (status `0x0`, identical 30,605 gas — classic `onlyOwner` revert), leaving the fee vaults at their original impls/recipients.

Root cause: the `migrations-sop` devnet family was bootstrapped with a plain L2 EOA as `L2ProxyAdmin.owner()` rather than the canonical `aliased(L1_PAO)`, so deposits arriving with `from = aliased(rootSafe)` are rejected.

On any canonical OP Stack chain the template already works correctly. This check is a safety net for misconfigured chains (devnets, mis-bootstrapped tenants) — operators get a clear simulation-time error instead of discovering the silent revert after signing.

## Usage

Add to `config.toml`:

```toml
l2RpcUrls = [
  "https://migrations-sop-1.optimism.io",  # URL...
  "opSepolia",                              # ...or foundry.toml rpc alias
]
```

Length must equal `l2chains.length` and order must match.

When the check fails, the revert message points operators at [`TransferL2PAOFromL1`](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/blob/main/src/template/TransferL2PAOFromL1.sol) as the fix.

## Test plan

- [x] `forge build` — compiles
- [x] `forge test --match-test testRegressionCallDataMatches_FeeVaultUpgradeTemplate` — passes (existing 034 fixture has no `l2RpcUrls`, hits the warn-and-skip path; calldata unchanged)
- [ ] Manual: run a sim with `l2RpcUrls` pointing at a chain where L2 PA is correctly owned by aliased L1 PAO → check passes silently
- [ ] Manual: run a sim with `l2RpcUrls` pointing at `migrations-sop-1` → check reverts with the expected diagnostic
